en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a small Byzantine church surrounded by a low metal fence on a street corner. The church has a stone façade, arched windows, and a central dome with Byzantine-style brickwork. Around the image, printed captions in Greek and French identify the site as a Byzantine church in Athens dedicated to St. Eleutherios. There are handwritten signatures or script across the lower part of the postcard.
